No characters, no faces, no letters, no legible UI text, no fake logos. The panels are tangible little cream product objects with blank black placeholder bars and a tiny orange rectangle. Sophisticated clean art direction, satin ivory ceramic, soft warm highlights, graphite details, subtle physical depth and bevels, studio render, restrained orange #ff6b1a accent, centered isolated object group fitting landscape 4:3. Entire background MUST be truly transparent alpha, no white rectangular backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object, no text. Crisp silhouettes, visually simple and readable at phone size. This illustrates monotonous templated output, not a screenshot of any actual product.
